title: Compute async invoice totals
summary: An invoice service must fetch simulated line items for several accounts and calculate each account total. The independent lookups can run concurrently, while the returned report must remain deterministic. Fetch simulated invoice lines concurrently and sum their totals.
requirements: For each line use Promise.resolve to simulate fetching it.
Return a single integer total in cents.
hints: Map lines to asynchronous amount calculations.
Wait for all amounts before reducing them to one sum.
